source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 6 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: If one quantity grows several times and the other grows the same number of times, they are directly proportional.
stages.headlineEnglish: If one quantity grows several times and the other grows the same number of times, they are directly proportional.

stages.headline: If one quantity grows several times while the other shrinks the same number of times, they are inversely proportional.
stages.headlineEnglish: If one quantity grows several times while the other shrinks the same number of times, they are inversely proportional.

stages.headline: For inversely proportional quantities the product stays the same: 6 workers take 12 days; how long for 9?
stages.headlineEnglish: For inversely proportional quantities the product stays the same: 6 workers take 12 days; how long for 9?

choices: The amount of goods bought and their cost
Speed and travel time (for the same route)
The side of a square and its perimeter
optionsQuiz.feedbackIncorrect: 🤔 Not quite. The correct answer is {correctText}.
